info.title: AgentDesk API
info.description: HTTP API behind the AgentDesk demo (fictional insurance products only). No authentication: the demo is public. Endpoints that spend model credit are rate limited per client IP plus a shared daily budget. Every response carries an x-request-id header that matches the structured log line for that request. This file is hand-written and kept in sync with app/api by tests/ops/openapi-contract.test.ts.

tags.name: support
tags.description: Support desk (M9): deterministic triage, SLA, escalation, handoff. Synthetic demo data.

get.summary: Liveness + readiness: config presence, database round trip, frozen knowledge base (3/20/45), rate-limiter table. Never calls OpenAI.

503.description: down: database unreachable or not configured

post.summary: Answer a question (Chinese or English) from the English product documents, with verbatim quotes and page citations, or refuse with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
post.x-rate-limit: 10 per 10 min per IP; shared 300/day model budget

example.query: 定期寿险有现金价值吗？

200.description: Grounded answer (may be a refusal; check refusal.isRefusal and evidenceStatus)

429.description: Rate limited (per-IP burst limit or the shared daily model budget). See Retry-After.

example.message: 请求太频繁，请稍后再试。Too many requests from this connection — please wait a few minutes and try again.

post.summary: Deterministic 13-row comparison draft for two products. No model call.

200.description: Comparison draft (comparisonStatus may be complete, partial or blocked)

post.summary: Optional neutral narrative for a comparison. The server rebuilds the draft from identifiers; failures return narrativeStatus 'unavailable' with HTTP 200.
post.x-rate-limit: 10 per 10 min per IP; shared 300/day model budget

429.description: Rate limited (per-IP burst limit or the shared daily model budget). See Retry-After.

example.message: 请求太频繁，请稍后再试。Too many requests from this connection — please wait a few minutes and try again.

post.summary: Send a comparison for human review. The server rebuilds the draft, freezes and hashes a snapshot, and computes routing. Idempotent: an open review for the same work is returned instead of a duplicate.

200.description: An open review for the same work already exists (action: existing_pending)

get.summary: One review exactly as stored, with its append-only event trail.

post.summary: Approve, reject (reason required) or request revision (instructions required). The reviewer identity is written by the server. Compare-and-set: a stale second decision gets 409 and changes nothing.

example.instructions: Add the surrender-charge schedule for both products.

409.description: REVIEW_STATE_CONFLICT: already decided in another session (body includes the current reviewItem)

get.summary: What the post-review automation WOULD send (eligibility, task type, payload) and past delivery runs. Sends nothing.

post.summary: Create the internal follow-up task via the n8n webhook (or record 'mocked' when no webhook is configured). Empty body by design; idempotent per terminal decision.

200.description: Automation description including the new run

400.description: Not eligible (e.g. review rejected or still pending); error is the reason code

post.summary: Transcribe a short spoken question. The transcript is returned for the user to edit; nothing is stored or auto-submitted.
post.x-rate-limit: 20 per 10 min per IP; shared 300/day model budget

audio.description: audio/webm, ogg, mp4, mpeg, wav or m4a; max 8 MB

429.description: Rate limited (per-IP burst limit or the shared daily model budget). See Retry-After.

example.message: 请求太频繁，请稍后再试。Too many requests from this connection — please wait a few minutes and try again.

get.summary: Ticket queue, sorted by SLA risk (breached, at risk, soonest due).

post.summary: Create a ticket. Triage (category, priority, route, cited draft, due dates) is computed server-side by rules + retrieval; no model, nothing is sent.

get.summary: One ticket with its append-only timeline, live SLA, allowed actions and the one primary action.

post.summary: Take one action (approve draft, log reply, escalate with packet, resolve, assign…). Compare-and-set on the status the caller saw.

409.description: TICKET_CONFLICT — someone acted first; body.detail is the current ticket

get.summary: End-of-shift handoff of every open ticket: SLA risk, last action, next step, blocker. Read-only, cron-safe.
First-response time, SLA hit rates, auto-draft rate and acceptance, escalation rate, backlog by priority — each with its definition.
Knowledge-base gaps: poorly matched answerable tickets grouped by unseen terms, with an article skeleton (answer left for a human).

RequestId.description: Correlates the response with its structured log line.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the current rate-limit window ends.

quote.description: Exact substring of the retrieved chunk (verified by code)

dimensions.description: 13 code-generated rows; every factual cell carries document, page and verbatim quote

snapshot.description: Frozen comparison draft; immutable at the database level

payload.description: Exactly what would be sent; no recipient field exists

requester.description: Display name. Use synthetic names only.

TicketDetail.description: ticket.triage holds the frozen triage result: rules fired, retrieved passages, match level with reasons, route reasons and the extractive draft with verbatim citations.

TicketActionInput.description: Discriminated by action. APPROVE_DRAFT/LOG_REPLY need replyText; REQUESTER_REPLIED/ENGINEERING_RETURNED need note; RESOLVE needs resolutionNote; ESCALATE needs escalation; ASSIGN needs assignee.
